evidence_plan.requirement: performance results of traditional machine learning models

payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance results for both DNN models and traditional machine learning models in the context of cyberbullying detection.

claims.text: DNN models showed significantly improved performance after oversampling the bullying class, with major improvements in evaluation measures compared to non-oversampled datasets.
Traditional machine learning models (LR, SVM, RF, NB) performed significantly lower than DNN models in cyberbullying detection tasks.
